hash_rule: SHA-256 over canonical approval JSON excluding approval_payload_sha256
consumption_rule: The first exact RUN_STARTED event binds and consumes the approval atomically for governed purposes.
rules: Approval is explicit and exact; silence is never approval.
Family, experiment, preregistration, inputs, dataset snapshots, split and action must match.
Expired, altered, reused, incomplete and unregistered approvals fail closed.
Approval to execute is not approval to interpret, promote or deploy.
